batch: W04 source-page corrections after R02 final findings
A040_status: Open for arbitrary finite graphs. Nacu verifies zero-field cycles; Kargin's printed nonzero-uniform-field theorem is not declared false, but this evidence pack audits only H=0 because the proof reflection f_k=-f_{n-k} is not automatic at H≠0. Static FKG/GKS/Holley do not imply finite-time or spectral-gap monotonicity. Sambale–Sinulis supplies only a sufficient weak-dependence route after both conditional-marginal and influence-norm bounds are verified; Paulin supplies fixed-chain mixing/concentration tools. Neither proves edgewise Ising gap monotonicity. Shirai refutes only a stronger fixed-time expectation statement. Diaconis–Stroock's printed Cheeger upper half β₁≤1−h² is flagged as internally inconsistent with the displayed h²/2 proof and an exact reversible-chain example; W04 uses only the weaker proof-supported form, pending review.

S002_lemma332_mixture_remark_audit.engine: Python 3 + SymPy from project .runtime; exact rational matrices
S002_lemma332_mixture_remark_audit.result: P all 1/2; P* diagonal 9/10/off-diagonal 1/10; δ=4/5. Common uniform stationary law and the lemma off-diagonal hypothesis hold. The source mixture residual Q has diagonal −11/10 and off-diagonal 21/10, so it is not a Markov kernel. The direct relaxation-time comparison still holds: τ₂(P)=1 ≤ δ⁻¹τ₂(P*)=25/4.
S002_lemma332_mixture_remark_audit.limitation: Exact audit of the following remark’s mixture interpretation only; it does not refute Lemma 3.32.

No arbitrary-graph edgewise gap proof or certified counterexample found.
A121/A122 are distribution-map/invariant-measure questions; W04S025/026 provide only the stated inner-kernel or k=2 interface and are not spectral-gap comparison tools.
W04S027’s printed Cheeger upper bound β₁≤1−h² conflicts with its proof-supported h²/2 bound and the exact reversible-chain check; this source-level discrepancy remains pending independent review.

LPW Theorem 15.10 author proof retains a source-level display discrepancy: p.239 prints factor 4, while p.240 counts 4^M pairs and the intermediate congestion bound does not imply the final printed factor. R02 separately accepted a library-derived alternate proof under the card’s finite zero-field homogeneous Ising and matching uniform discrete clock assumptions; this does not fix or replace the source proof.

Aldous–Fill Lemma 3.29 prints a lower edge/vertex ratio that is contradicted by an exact two-state lazy chain; the displayed proof yields the corrected min-vertex/max-edge lower factor. Card and skill now preserve the printed expression and isolate the proof-derived correction pending final review.
